purpose: Review city-local registry basis and anonymous geometry-only routes without querying personal/property attributes.
primaryPublisher: Kandahar Municipality; Ministry of Urban Development and Housing / Land Management Affairs
registryBasis: Kandahar Municipality publishes a city master plan and separate plans for each of its 15 nahias, establishing local planning-map coverage but not cadastral polygons. Afghanistan’s Ministry of Urban Development and Housing says its Land Management Affairs unit is responsible for cadastre surveying, deed registration and informal-urban-area registration; its Pashto land magazine reports 3,696 informal houses surveyed and registered in Kandahar city, a limited regularization program rather than a complete city register. No anonymous parcel geometry service or schema was found.

officialSources.observation: Kandahar Municipality’s Pashto page links a city master plan and plans for all 15 municipal nahias. These are planning maps, not proof of cadastral parcel geometry.

The Ministry’s Pashto land magazine reports that 3,696 informal houses in Kandahar city had been surveyed and registered through the informal-urban-settlement registration program. This is limited program evidence, not citywide cadastral completeness.

The Ministry describes its Geodesy, Cadaster and Deed directorate responsibilities, including cadastral survey, registering deeds and land-management information, and registration of informal urban areas. This establishes institutional remit but is national-level.
National Development Corporation material describes construction of a provincial land-and-deeds directorate facility in Kandahar city (Nahia 10); this is local office evidence, not an open dataset.
